title: EXP-07 Model Architecture Contract and Parameter Specification

input_contract.channel_semantics: Sentinel-1 Level-1 GRD VV channel (1 band)

output_contract.semantics: Raw unnormalized logits (no softmax / sigmoid applied in model output)

batchnorm_and_batch_size_analysis.finding: At batch_size=8 on 72 training tiles, each epoch contains only 9 forward steps. Standard BatchNorm2d with default momentum=0.1 may suffer noisy running mean/variance estimates across disparate SAR scenes (e.g. calm ocean vs severe storm convection). Recommendation: evaluate GroupNorm (num_groups=16) or reduce BN momentum to 0.05, or use gradient accumulation (virtual batch_size=16) to stabilize normalization.

architecture_recommendation.rationale: ResNet18-UNet provides an ideal parameter budget (~14.3M parameters, ~54.7 MB) for 72 training tiles, reducing overfitting risk compared to ResNet34 (~24.4M parameters, ~93 MB) while retaining the deep receptive field and ImageNet pre-trained feature extractor benefits lacking in VanillaUNet.
